details.description: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, nicknamed 'Nano Banana', is Google DeepMind's native image generation and editing model, launched in preview on August 26, 2025 with a stable version following soon after. Built on the Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal backbone, it generates images from text and performs prompt-based edits -- background changes, object removal, pose changes, colorizing old photos -- while keeping a consistent character or subject across turns and blending multiple input images into one output. Google's current image-generation documentation calls it 'the legacy pioneer of the Nano Banana series' and recommends customers move to its newer Nano Banana models for better quality, speed and pricing.
advantages: Multi-turn conversational image editing: users can keep refining an image with follow-up natural-language instructions.
Blends multiple input images into a single output image while keeping character/subject consistency across prompts.
Supports natural-language local edits such as background blurring, object removal, pose changes and colorizing black-and-white photos.
Every generated image carries an invisible SynthID watermark for provenance.
disadvantages: Google's own documentation calls it 'the legacy pioneer of the Nano Banana series' and recommends customers transition to newer Nano Banana models for better quality, faster generation and lower pricing.
Google's own deprecations page lists this exact model id as released October 2, 2025 with an announced shutdown date of October 2, 2026, replaced by gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview.
At launch Google said it was still improving long-form text rendering, character consistency, and fine factual detail in generated images.
Text-only interface for prompting; no dedicated resolution or aspect-ratio controls are documented for this model, unlike its Nano Banana Pro successor.
use_cases: Prompt-guided photo editing (background swaps, object removal, retouching, colorization)
Product mockups, real-estate listing images and home-design visualization

notes: No accuracy-style (0-100, higher-is-better) benchmark for this model was found on the maker pages I opened, so evaluations is left empty. Google's current image-generation docs (checked 2026-09-24) label this model 'legacy' and push users toward newer Nano Banana models. CORRECTION: the earlier version of this note called the catalog's 2027-03-15 deprecation_date merely 'further out than the plain chat 2.5 models' without checking the specific announced date. Google's own deprecations page (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations, checked 2026-09-24) states `gemini-2.5-flash-image` was released October 2, 2025 and has an announced shutdown date of October 2, 2026 -- about a week after today's research date, and over five months EARLIER than the catalog's 2027-03-15 deprecation_date -- with gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview as the recommended replacement. Kind is 'chat' per the target's Bud routing, but the model's actual function is native image generation/editing, so the description covers that rather than generic chat traits.
